steps.label: verificar sidebar expandida e botão habilitado
steps.js: (() => { const aside = document.querySelector('aside'); const btn = aside.querySelector('button[title*="barra lateral"], button[title*="menu lateral"]'); return JSON.stringify({ width: aside.clientWidth, isCollapsed: aside.clientWidth < 100, disabled: btn ? btn.disabled : null }); })()

steps.label: verificar auto-colapso e botão desabilitado com tooltip
steps.js: (() => { const aside = document.querySelector('aside'); const btn = aside.querySelector('button[title*="Aumente a largura"], button[title*="menu"]'); return JSON.stringify({ width: aside.clientWidth, isCollapsed: aside.clientWidth < 100, disabled: btn ? btn.disabled : null, title: btn ? btn.getAttribute('title') : null }); })()

steps.label: verificar desbloqueio em viewport amplo
steps.js: (() => { const aside = document.querySelector('aside'); const btn = aside.querySelector('button'); return JSON.stringify({ width: aside.clientWidth, disabled: btn ? btn.disabled : null }); })()
